turns.say: How do I choose the right cricket bat?
turns.message:
To choose the right cricket bat, consider the player's skill level, the bat's weight and pick-up, and the type of ball used [1].

For beginners, a forgiving bat with a large sweet spot and durable blade is recommended. Intermediate players benefit from a lighter pick-up and better-grade willow, while advanced players might prefer high-grade English willow with a powerful profile [1].

Most adult bats weigh between 1.1 kg and 1.3 kg. A lighter bat is easier to swing, while a heavier bat offers more power. The feel of the bat (pick-up) can vary even with the same weight [1].

turns.say: What should I do if the product is defective?
turns.message:
If a product seems defective, you should describe the fault in a support case [1]. Whether a fault is covered depends on the warranty terms for the product and is decided by a person, not by the assistant [1].

To make a warranty claim, you need to keep your order number and report the defect within 7 days of finding it. You will also need to send clear photos of the defect [3]. A warranty claim is not a return [3].

If the product injured you or could injure someone, stop using it and mention this in the support case. A case flagged as safety-related is shown to support as urgent [2].

turns.say: How does the delivery and return process work?
turns.message:
After your payment is captured, DSports automatically creates a shipment for your order [3]. You can track your order using the tracking number, which starts with TRK [3]. The delivery status will progress from CREATED to DELIVERED [3].

You can return a product from a delivered order within 7 days of delivery [1, 2]. To request a return, tell the assistant which order and product you want to return, or open the order and choose to return the product [1].
